It provides confidentiality and trade-secret protection alongside the Alaska Uniform Trade Secrets Act (AS 45.50.910–.945), customer and employee non-solicitation, an optional customer non-dealing covenant scoped to the customers and information the employer procured at its own expense, an optional non-compete drawn to the reasonable-necessity gate, optional non-investment, sale-of-business public-injury weighing for covenants tied to a business sale, and a reasonable-alteration posture that the drafting does not rely on — judicial rescue of an overbroad covenant is available only to an employer that carries the burden of proving good-faith drafting, with willful overreach forfeiting alteration. Drafted as a starting point for licensed counsel review.
